title: Good enough pot
text:
Good enough pot. I am revisiting my review two years after my purchase. The reason this pot missed a 5 star is because the handle is a bit too heavy for the pot. Hence, you have to center it very well on the stove till you add something in it to balance the weight. Otherwise, food has not burned in it yet, and it is easy to clean. The top knob on the lid came loose because the silicon washer holding up the screw got cut by the steel rivet. Bonus: looks good!
